data.title: Database Administrator
data.content: Database Administrator is responsible for implementing application systems to support the bank's business goals while striving for the highest quality. We aim to provide extensive system support by delivering POST JOB reliable application solutions. We are seeking an experienced Database Administrator to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for managing and optimizing the database systems that power our core banking system, leveraging technologies such as SQL Server, Oracle Database, Data Guard, Golden Gate, and relevant components from our technology stack.

Medical Care: 24/7 medical team available to assist employees in case of illness or injury.

Paid Leave: 15 days of paid leave after 6 months of employment. For employees returning to their home country, the company will cover the cost of airfare. Employees who choose not to take their leave will receive a bonus based on their salary level.
Salary Increment: Two salary increments per year based on individual KPI and market rates.
Contract Renewal: A bonus of 20,000 RMB upon signing a new contract after the completion of the current one. 13th to 17th month salary based on the employee's tenure with the company.
New Employee Training: Comprehensive training provided by a team of experts to assist new employees.
